{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm total number of rows
print(f"Total penguins: {len(penguins)}")

# Check how many have missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isna().sum()
print(f"Missing flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper}")

# Check if the missingness is random or systematic
# Look at the species of the missing flipper_length_mm
missing_data = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isna()]
print("\nSpecies distribution of missing flipper data:")
display(missing_data['species'].value_counts())

# Check if missingness is tied to sex
print("\nSex distribution of missing flipper data:")
display(missing_data['sex'].value_counts())"}
